tahanie_bremena.png.initial: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset tahanie_bremena.png for a Slovak school physics textbook. Create a clear wide scientific illustration on pure white background: on left a small wooden crate resting on horizontal grey floor, rope from its top-right corner stretches diagonally up and right, a person standing on the right pulls the rope, facing the crate. In open white space above/left of the rope show a LARGE precise force vector decomposition diagram; do not place diagram on the person. Three vectors share exactly one common origin at the crate's rope attachment point: orange resultant F diagonally up-right along the rope; blue component Fₓ horizontally right; green component Fᵧ vertically up. Orange arrow tip coincides with the top-right corner of a dotted construction rectangle whose bottom-left corner is the origin, bottom-right is the blue arrow tip, top-left is the green arrow tip. Label an arc α between horizontal right component and diagonal resultant near the common origin. Leave generous label space. Only labels F, Fₓ, Fᵧ, α, no other text, no title, no formulas, no extra arrows. Vectors must be rigorously geometrically consistent: F = Fₓ + Fᵧ. No gravity, friction or normal force arrows in this diagram. Gentle clean textbook illustration shading on crate and person, vector diagram crisp thick lines, correct hand anatomy, no logos, no watermark. This teaches resolution of an angled pulling force into horizontal and vertical components.
